SCALE.label: SCALE CANDIDATE
SCALE.action: Immediate production of high-intent content, multiple angles, landing page comparison.

TEST.label: TEST
TEST.action: Produce pilot test content (1-2 videos/articles), validate CTR and conversion tracking.

RETEST.label: RETEST / NEW ANGLE
RETEST.action: Hold production until distinct positioning, audience sub-niche, or higher commission angle is identified.

KILL.label: KILL
KILL.action: Archive candidate; low buyer intent, poor economics, or high compliance risk.

rubric_guidelines.Demand: Search volume, social buzz, active user growth, and market adoption (0-25 pts)
rubric_guidelines.BuyerIntent: Urgency of problem solved, willingness to pay, commercial search keywords (0-20 pts)
rubric_guidelines.CommissionEconomics: Commission % or flat payout, recurring vs one-time, EPC/AOV, cookie duration (0-15 pts)
rubric_guidelines.ContentFit: Ease of demonstration, visual hook potential, case study compatibility, format fit (0-15 pts)
rubric_guidelines.Competition: SERP difficulty, saturation of affiliate reviews; higher score = healthier competitive gap (0-10 pts)
rubric_guidelines.Trend: Google Trends slope, tech adoption curve (e.g. AI boom, remote work, automation) (0-10 pts)
rubric_guidelines.ComplianceRisk: Strictness of program terms, trademark bidding bans, payout reliability, disclosure hurdles (0-5 pts)
